name: ask-credential-switching
description: Best effort, ask only. Asks a person before a shell command switches the identity later commands act as: aws --profile, AWS_PROFILE= or AWS keys (also $env:), sts assume-role, configure set of a key; gcloud account, configuration, login or impersonation; az account set, az login as a principal or identity; kubectl use-context or set-credentials; writes to ~/.aws, ~/.config/gcloud, ~/.azure. Names in .chock/credential-allowlist.json pass. Misses: scripts, SDKs, env files, credential_process. [Session-enforced in Cursor by a beforeShellExecution hook: a matched command is denied before it runs (witnessed blocking on Cursor, 2026-08-24). The hook needs git, a Python 3.11+ (python3, python or py; the Windows Store stub is skipped) and a usable bash resolved from PATH. The hook entry sets `failClosed`, which Cursor's hooks documentation (cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks) says blocks the action when the hook fails to run, so a hook that cannot start refuses the command. If the guard itself crashes, the hook returns `permission: "ask"`, which beforeShellExecution honours. Repo-wide enforcement at commit time and in CI still needs `chock sync`.]
